messages:
Sam H: Heads up — we're finalizing travel for the Tokyo offsite (May). Quick q: will people get pocket WiFi or local SIM? Any tips on staying under 8kg carry-on?
Anya P: I did Tokyo last year — buy a local eSIM (Airalo) if your phone supports it. Pocket WiFi is ok for groups but battery + extra device is annoying.
Devon: Agree with eSIM. For tether-heavy days (sharing with multiple devices) pocket WiFi wins. Battery life is the tradeoff.
Maria L: For 8kg carry-on: compression cubes + wear sneakers on plane. Also laundromats in Shinjuku are lifesavers if you want to pack light.
Sam H: @Anya P @Jules any recs for JR Pass vs individual tickets?
Anya P: JR Pass only worth it if doing long hops (Osaka/Kyoto). For Tokyo-only, get a Suica/Pasmo card and top up as you go — works on trains/buses/convenience stores.
Jules: I can coordinate group arrivals + neighborhood hotel recs. What's folks' preferred arrival day? Poll: arrive evening Thu or morning Fri? :thinking_face:
Elliot (travelbot): Reminder: submit pre-approved travel reimbursements via https://expenses.redwood.com/submit — per-diem rules updated 2025-01.
Devon: Also heads-up: Japan outlets are Type A (two flat pins), 100V. Most phone/laptop chargers are fine but bring a tiny adapter and a power bank for long train days.
Maria L: Packing list (my compressed version):
```
- 1x carry-on (max 8kg)
- 1x daypack
- 3 shirts, 2 bottoms
- 1x lightweight rain shell
- compression cubes
- plug adapter (Type A)
- pocket tissues + hand sanitizer
- power bank
```
Sam H: Any tips for cheap SIM/pocket WiFi vendors at Narita/Haneda?
Anya P: At airport counters: eSIM booths are fewer. I liked Mobal (airport pick up) and Ninja WiFi for pocket. Pre-book online to avoid queues.
Jules: If you're checking bags, watch airline weight limits — some carriers are strict on carry-on vs checked weight. If anyone wants to ship souvenirs, KURONEKO Yamato has easy boxes and hotel pickup.
Maria L: Also if anyone cares, I can bring a few universal plug strips to stash in the hotel lounge.
Sam H: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll make a travel checklist doc and ping the group for arrivals. :airplane: :sparkles:
